subject.title: fix(feishu): use union_id as fallback for @mention detection in multi-bot groups

question: Which Feishu bot identity strategy should become canonical for multi-bot group @mention admission when native open_id values are app-scoped?
rationale: The branch changes message admission behavior, the proposed union_id source is disputed by the linked issue, and the current conflict spans Feishu identity surfaces rather than a mechanical rebase.

options.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
options.body: Rework this PR on current main only after proving the stable identity source and covering all admission paths.

options.title: Supersede With Broader Feishu Work
options.body: Keep this branch as investigation context and replace it only when a broader Feishu identity PR lands with positive proof.

options.title: Accept Narrow union_id Direction
options.body: Maintainers can deliberately accept the union_id fallback only with live proof that it populates and tests for sibling paths.

recommendation.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
